limitations: No identification of the nonreduced Jacobian scheme or full conductor.
Generic transverse type only; boundary singularities not analytically classified.
scientific_integrity.statement: The secant sextic of the monomial curve with exponents 0,1,3,4,5 has one integral reduced singular surface of degree seven with two boundary lines and generic two-branch nodal transverse type.

source_ids: Ranestad, The Degree of the Secant Variety and the Join of Monomial Curves, 2004-05-27, https://library.slmath.org/preprints/files/2004/2004-007/2004-007.pdf

title: The degree-seven double surface of a punctured quintic secant sextic
